allowed_generation_route: Codex session authoring; no separately billed model API generation
checkpoint: Report the three-unit trial with findings, correction passes, timing/usage observations and remaining teacher decisions before scaling.
counts_policy: Old eight-lesson counts are inventory only. Record explicit source allocation, otherwise justify lesson count from coverage and prerequisites.
metrics_limit: Account usage includes unrelated concurrent activity and is not a per-unit token/cost meter. Teacher correction time is measured only when a teacher reports it.
